title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
reason: Major bank rolling out a licensed stablecoin to 3 million retail users is a significant adoption milestone, corroborated by two sources.

sources.summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.
PayMe users will be able to activate a stablecoin wallet in-app in the coming days for peer-to-peer and peer-to-merchant payments.

title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
reason: A security-driven delay to a major Ethereum upgrade is an important protocol development with a concrete technical cause.

sources.summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.
